## Send n8n failures to Flashduty
1. Set a unique instance_id and severity in Flashduty settings.
2. In Send to Flashduty, set the push URL without its integration_key query parameter. Keep other URL parameters.
3. Select a Query Auth credential: Name = integration_key, Value = your Flashduty integration key.
4. Save/publish this workflow and select it as the Error workflow of each monitored workflow.

Automatic failures only. Each failed execution creates an independent alert; no automatic recovery. Never share an export containing your credentials or integration URL.
Docs: https://docs.flashduty.com/en/on-call/integration/alert-integration/alert-sources/n8n
